data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing Material 3 expressive components and shapes.
data.what_it_does: Bundles Material 3 expressive components such as segmented lists, dismissible cards, expandable lists, menus, dropdowns, buttons, floating toolbars, shapes, sliders, color schemes, haptics, progress indicators, typography, and bottom sheets.
use_when: You want to build an app using Material 3 Expressive design tokens and components.
You need specialized expressive widgets like spring-animated dismissibles, expandable cards, or segmented lists.
avoid_when: You need standard Cupertino widgets or strict standard Material components without expressive motions.
You are using a Flutter SDK version older than 3.47.0 (unless using legacy version 0.1.6).
strengths: Comprehensive collection of Material 3 expressive components and animations.
Includes physics-driven spring animations, reordering lists, and shape morphing.
weaknesses: Requires Flutter SDK >=3.47.0 and external standalone material_ui package dependencies.
Contains deprecated legacy card list components that require migration to segmented lists.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter SDK >=3.47.0, material_ui >=1.3.0, and importing material_ui.dart and m3e_core.dart.
